سَحْسَحٌ : see سَحٌّ. ―
-b2- Also, applied to land (أَرْضٌ), (assumed tropical:) Wide, or spacious: but IDrd says, I know not the truth of this. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also, and ↓ سَحْسَحَةٌ , A court, or a spacious portion in which is no building or that is vacant, of a house, (S, K, TA,) and of a place of alighting, or of a settlement, or of a collection of houses or tents: the former expl. by IAar as meaning a man's quarter, or tract, in which he alights. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
